evidence.summary: Python 1294 passed with one existing deprecation warning. Frontend 87 passed with maxWorkers=1; parallel load during install caused an existing first-render timeout, sequential rerun passed. Rust 8 passed, one opt-in test ignored. Circuit-only waits, stale deadlines, half-open HTTP400 versus 401/429/503, all judge types, endpoint keys, no-project settings and reinstall preservation covered.

Signed build and install complete; runtime 32cfe0d90a1bfaeadb6f. All 60 packaged Python modules match source. Seven provider tests rerun after explicitly importing the installed runtime. Runtime switch backup: backups/20261026T084922Z-25a56eed; previous app bundle retained.

Installed native settings with/without project match shared deepseek-v4.1-flash. Fruit-fly extraction, ModelJudge and single-token judge share model/endpoint; single-token output remains 1 and old route cache is not reusable. Native map 1089 nodes/575 edges; seven MCP tools, recall/expand and six registered Hook events work with model_calls=0. Project config and graph/index counts unchanged across read smoke. Old fruit-fly runner 59444 from runtime 53235649d98d8849429c and one descendant were stopped after detecting continued pre-upgrade looping; only this chat queue item was backed up and fenced blocked with target 110106 preserved. Backup: backups/fruitfly-provider-pause-1793004794/continuation-item.json. Authenticated models-list GET confirms saved global alias unavailable, current list includes deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017. No model inference or other real project inspection.
